## 🌍 World-Editor+ Модпак для **Fabric**, ориентированный на редактирование мира, импорт изображений и расширенные инструменты строительства. Идеально подходит для создателей контента, строителей и масштабных проектов. --- ### 📦 Моды
Основные - [Axiom](https://modrinth.com/mod/axiom) (MIT) - [Litematica](https://modrinth.com/mod/litematica) (MPL-2.0) - [Image Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/image) (MIT) - [Image2Map](https://modrinth.com/mod/image2map) (MIT)
Дополнения - [Distant Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/distant-horizons) (GPL-3.0) - [Litematica Printer](https://modrinth.com/mod/litematica-printer) (MIT) - [LitematicaWand](https://modrinth.com/mod/litematicawand) (MIT) - [Toggleable Item Frames](https://modrinth.com/mod/toggleableitemframes) (MIT) - [Full Brightness Toggle](https://modrinth.com/mod/full-brightness-toggle) (MIT)
Производительность - [Chunky](https://modrinth.com/mod/chunky) (MIT) - [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) (ISC) - [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core) (MIT) - [ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast) (MIT) - [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium) (MIT)
Прочее - [Reese's Sodium Options](https://modrinth.com/mod/reeses-sodium-options) (GPL-3.0) - [Sodium Extra](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-extra) (MIT) - [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) (MIT)
Зависимости - [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) (Apache-2.0) - [MaLiLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/malilib) (MPL-2.0) - [Collective](https://modrinth.com/mod/collective) (All Rights Reserved) - [Axiom](https://modrinth.com/mod/axiom) (MIT) - [Litematica](https://modrinth.com/mod/litematica) (MPL-2.0)
